items.headline: 一种模型，模拟多种物质运动
items.headline_en: One Model for Many Kinds of Motion
items.summary: 11月9日，MIT介绍WorldParticle模拟框架：把砂粒、液体、弹性物体和蛋白质等表示为粒子，由神经网络预测粒子下一步的位置与运动。团队在六类物理系统中测试了同一种模型架构。统一表示不同物质，有助于研究流体与柔软物体相互作用，减少为每类问题另写模拟程序的工作。
items.summary_en: On November 9, MIT described WorldParticle, which represents materials such as sand, liquids, elastic objects and proteins as particles. A neural network predicts how those particles move next. The team tested the same model architecture across six types of physical system. Representing different materials in a common way could help researchers study interactions between fluids and soft objects while reducing the need to design separate simulators for each problem.

items.headline: 把混凝土梁的模具缝出来
items.headline_en: Sewing a Mould for a Concrete Beam
items.summary: 11月6日，MIT介绍用缝制布模浇筑的3米概念验证梁。混凝土抗压，钢筋抗拉；优化传力路径后，同设计承载目标下，混凝土用量约为传统梁的三分之一，钢筋约为一半。加载至设计荷载30%的试验中，中点挠度与预测相差约2%。把复杂形状变成可缝制裁片，为节材结构提供了制造方法。
items.summary_en: On November 6, MIT described a three-metre proof-of-concept beam cast in a sewn fabric mould. Concrete resists compression; steel carries tension. Optimising load paths cut material use to about one-third the concrete and half the steel of a conventional beam with the same design load. Tests reached 30 percent of design load, with central deflection within about 2 percent of predictions. Fabric patterns make complex material-saving shapes easier to manufacture.

items.headline: 少量实验，也能预测分子性质
items.headline_en: Predicting Molecular Properties from Less Data
items.summary: 11月6日，MIT介绍CheMeleon分子预测法。模型先学习约100万个分子的结构与约1600种可计算特征，再用少量实验数据调整，预测溶解度等目标性质。这像先掌握化学中的通用关系，再学习一道新题。在实验样本稀少时，已有知识可帮助筛选值得合成、测试的候选分子。
items.summary_en: On November 6, MIT described CheMeleon, a method for predicting molecular properties. It first learns relationships between the structures of about a million molecules and roughly 1,600 computable descriptors. Researchers then fine-tune it with small experimental datasets to predict properties such as solubility. Like learning general chemistry before tackling a new problem, this prior knowledge helps select promising molecules to synthesise and test when experimental data are scarce.

items.headline: 让造血干细胞增多，也保留本领
items.headline_en: Growing Blood Stem Cells Without Losing Their Abilities
items.summary: 11月6日，Stowers研究所介绍脐带血干细胞培养研究。三维支架与多种信号模拟骨髓环境，帮助细胞增殖，同时避免过早成熟。培养后的细胞先后移植到两批小鼠中，仍能持续重建血液与免疫系统。研究既数细胞数量，也检验长期功能，为扩大未来移植用细胞的来源提供依据。
items.summary_en: On November 6, the Stowers Institute described research growing human cord-blood stem cells. A three-dimensional scaffold and several signals mimic bone marrow, supporting multiplication while preventing premature maturation. After transfer into one group of mice and then a second, the cultured cells could still rebuild blood and immune systems. Testing long-term function alongside cell numbers helps researchers develop ways to expand the supply of cells for future transplants.

items.headline: 用射电波，看清遥远星系
items.headline_en: Radio Waves Bring Distant Galaxies into Focus
items.summary: 11月5日，莱顿大学团队公布LOFAR射电图像：在约25个满月大小的天区中，辨认出近6.3万个射电源。团队结合200小时观测，并改进校准与数据处理。更清晰的图像能区分恒星形成区和黑洞驱动的喷流；射电波还能穿过遮挡星光的尘埃，补充可见光望远镜看到的宇宙。
items.summary_en: On November 5, a Leiden-led team reported a LOFAR radio image revealing nearly 63,000 sources across an area about 25 times the full Moon. Combining 200 hours of observations with improved calibration and processing sharpened the view. Researchers can better distinguish star-forming regions from jets powered by black holes. Radio waves also penetrate dust that hides starlight, complementing the picture of the Universe provided by visible-light telescopes.

items.headline: 臭氧洞的面积和深度，是两回事
items.headline_en: Ozone-Hole Area and Depth Tell Different Stories
items.summary: 11月4日，NASA与NOAA报告：南极臭氧洞9月7日至10月13日平均面积约2500万平方公里，居48年监测第七。强极涡维持寒冷环境，有利于氯、溴破坏臭氧。面积衡量低臭氧区有多广，浓度衡量损耗有多深；今年面积大，损耗却未达以往最严重水平。年际天气波动与臭氧层长期恢复可以并存。
items.summary_en: On November 4, NASA and NOAA reported an average Antarctic ozone-hole area of about 25 million square kilometres from September 7 to October 13, seventh largest in 48 years. A strong polar vortex maintained cold conditions that favour ozone destruction by chlorine and bromine. Area measures the extent of low ozone; concentration indicates depletion depth. This year's large hole was less deeply depleted than earlier extremes. Year-to-year weather fluctuations can coexist with long-term recovery.

previous_answers.headline: 在一张平放的圆形薄饼上切七条直线。每刀都贯穿薄饼，切出的部分不能移动或叠放。最多能得到多少块？请说明为什么不可能更多，并说明怎样达到这个数量。
previous_answers.headline_en: Cut a flat circular pancake with seven straight cuts. Each cut goes all the way across; you may not move or stack the pieces. What is the greatest number of pieces possible? Explain both why you cannot do better and how to attain your answer.
previous_answers.explanation: 第k刀至多与前面k−1刀相交，因而至多增加k块。总数至多为1＋1＋2＋…＋7＝29。让各刀互不平行、任意两刀的交点都在饼内，且没有三刀交于同一点，即可达到上限。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Cut k meets at most k−1 earlier cuts, so it adds at most k pieces. Thus the maximum is 1+1+2+…+7=29. Make the cuts nonparallel, with every pairwise intersection inside the pancake and no three cuts meeting at one point, to attain it.

previous_answers.headline: 一段楼梯共有10级，每次可以上1级或2级，但不能连续两次都上2级。从地面恰好到达第10级，共有多少种走法？只要步长顺序不同，就算不同走法。请用有条理的计数说明理由。
previous_answers.headline_en: A staircase has 10 steps. Each move climbs one or two steps, but two two-step moves may not occur consecutively. How many ways are there to reach step 10 exactly from the ground? Different sequences of move lengths count as different ways. Justify your count systematically.
previous_answers.explanation: 按跨两级的次数分类：0、1、2、3次时，分别有1、9、21、10种走法。先排好跨一级的动作，再把跨两级的动作放进不同空位（包括两端），就不会连续跨两级。总计1＋9＋21＋10＝41。
previous_answers.explanation_en: With 0, 1, 2 or 3 two-step moves, there are respectively 1, 9, 21 or 10 routes. Arrange the one-step moves first, then place two-step moves into distinct gaps, including both ends, so none are consecutive. Total: 1+9+21+10=41.

previous_answers.headline: 把四个非负整数按顺时针顺序写在一个圆周上。每轮同时更新四个数：用这个数与顺时针下一个数之差的绝对值替换它。计算时只能使用本轮更新前的数。先试试顺时针排列的1、3、7、12。无论开始时选哪四个非负整数，最后都会变成0、0、0、0吗？请证明。
previous_answers.headline_en: Write four nonnegative integers around a circle. In each round, simultaneously replace every number by the absolute difference between it and its clockwise neighbour, using the numbers from the start of that round. Try 1, 3, 7, 12 in clockwise order. Must every starting choice eventually become 0, 0, 0, 0? Prove your answer.
previous_answers.explanation: 示例6轮归零。只看奇偶，每轮差的奇偶与两数之和相同；连续算4轮，四数全偶。因此每4轮所有数都多一个因子2。同时最大值从不增加。若起初最大值为M，取2的某个幂大于M；经过足够多轮，四数只能全为0。
previous_answers.explanation_en: The example reaches zero in six rounds. Modulo 2, differences act like sums; after four rounds every entry is even. Thus each block of four rounds adds a factor of 2 to all entries, while their maximum never increases. Once that power of 2 exceeds the original maximum, all four entries must be zero.

challenges.headline: 选一个三位数，要求百位与个位相差至少2。把它的数字顺序倒过来，用较大的数减去较小的数。再把所得差的数字顺序倒过来，将这两个数相加。不必知道最初选的数，你能预测最后的结果吗？说明理由。（倒序后开头的0可以略去。）
challenges.headline_en: Choose a three-digit number whose first and last digits differ by at least 2. Reverse its digits, then subtract the smaller number from the larger. Reverse the digits of the difference and add these two numbers. Can you predict the final total without knowing the starting number? Explain why. Any leading zero in a reversed number may be omitted.

challenges.headline_en: Twelve cards are numbered 1 to 12. Shuffle them thoroughly and draw three without replacement. What is the probability that their sum is divisible by 3? Explain your answer by counting cases, rather than relying only on a simulation.

challenges.headline: 7名选手进行单循环比赛：每两人恰好比赛一场，每场都有一名胜者，没有平局。证明：无论比赛结果如何，总能把7人排成一列，使每个人都赢过紧挨在自己后面的人。注意：不要求一个人赢过自己后面的所有人。
challenges.headline_en: Seven players compete in a round-robin tournament: every pair plays exactly once, and every match has one winner, with no draws. Prove that, whatever the results, the players can always be arranged in a line so that each player beat the person immediately after them. A player need not have beaten everyone farther down the line.
